DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 申請書をお取りになる前に、ご用件を伺います。どちらへ出す書類をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before you take an application form, may I ask what you need? Where will you submit the document you are looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもの習い事の申込みに使います。依頼文には住所がわかる書類とだけ書いてあり、種類が決められません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 習い事の申込みで住所がわかる書類を求められ種類が不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is for enrolling my child in an extracurricular class. The request only says a document showing our address, so I cannot work out which kind to get.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you need a document showing your address for an extracurricular class application, but do not know which kind.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 依頼文を一緒に読みましょう。本人分だけなのか、ご家族の情報も必要なのか、記載はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us read the request together. Does it say whether it needs only your information or information about your family as well?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家族分と書かれていますが、同じ家に住む全員なのか、申込む子どもだけなのかわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 全同居者か申込む子どものみか依頼文からわからないと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says for the family, but I do not know whether that means everyone living in the same home or only the child enrolling.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the request does not make clear whether it means all household members or just the child enrolling.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その範囲は提出先に確かめる必要があります。必要のない情報まで載せることを避けたいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: You need to check that scope with the organization receiving it. We want to avoid including information they do not need.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 先に提出先へ聞きます。人数の範囲以外に、確認しておく点をメモしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 提出先への確認を先に行い人数以外の確認事項もメモしたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will ask them first. I would also like to write down what to check besides the number of people to include.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check with the receiving organization first and want to note other things to ask besides whose information to include.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 書類の正式な名称と、載せる項目を尋ねるためのメモにしてはいかがでしょう。ここで受付できるかは指定がわかってから確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: How about noting down that you should ask for the document's official name and the information to include? We will check whether we can accept the application here once their requirements are clear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 正式な名称と項目を聞いてきます。今持っている申請書には、まだ何も書かずにおいてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 正式名称と記載項目を聞く予定を述べ記入を待ってよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will ask for its official name and the required information. Is it all right to leave the application form I have completely blank for now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will ask for the official document name and required information, and ask whether you may wait before filling in the form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今日は相談として伺いましたので、申請する内容が決まってから書きましょう。依頼文も次回お持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Today I have heard your question as a consultation, so let us fill it in once you know what you are applying for. Please bring the request again next time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は申請せず、提出先の返事と依頼文を持って改めて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本日は申請せず提出先の返事と依頼文を持って再度相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not apply today. I will bring their reply and the request and come back to discuss it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not apply today and will return with the receiving organization's reply and request for another consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 必要な範囲がわかれば、その内容で相談を続けられます。それでは、確認が済みましたらまたお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Once the necessary scope is clear, we can continue discussing it on that basis. Please come back after you have checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票の記入で手が止まっていますね。書き方でわからない言葉がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have stopped while filling in the medical questionnaire. Are there any words in the instructions you do not understand?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 服用中という欄の意味がわかりません。先月飲んで、もう飲んでいない薬もここに書くのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 服用中の意味と先月までの薬をその欄に書くかを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I do not understand the field marked currently taking. Do I also write medicine I took last month but no longer take here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese what currently taking means and whether medicine you took until last month belongs in that field.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 服用中は、今飲んでいるという意味です。この練習用の用紙では、以前の薬については下の欄で伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Currently taking means medicine you are taking now. On this practice form, we ask about previous medicines in the field below.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、先月の薬は下の欄に書きます。今の薬はあるのですが、名前を正確に覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 過去の薬を下の欄に分けると確認し現在の名称は正確に覚えていないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I will put last month's medicine in the lower field. I am taking medicine now, but I do not remember its exact name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you will put previous medicine in the lower field and explain that you do not remember the exact name of your current medicine.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 名前を推測して書くより、わかる資料があれば見せていただけますか。袋や記録はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Rather than guessing the name, could you show us any information that identifies it? Do you have the bag or a record?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 薬の袋を家に置いてきました。携帯電話に撮った写真ならありますが、読んでいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 薬の袋は家にあるが携帯の写真を見てもらえるか頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I left the medicine bag at home. I have a photo on my phone; could you read it for me?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the medicine bag is at home and ask whether they can look at a photo on your phone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写真で文字が確認できるか見てみましょう。写っていない内容までわかったことにはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us see whether the writing is readable in the photo. We cannot treat information that is not shown as confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらの写真です。端が切れているので、見えない部分は不明として相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 写真の端が切れているため読めない部分を不明として相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Here is the photo. The edge is cut off, so I would like to discuss the unreadable parts as unknown.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the photo's edge is cut off and you want to treat the unreadable parts as unknown during the consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 不明な点はこちらで確認事項として記録します。下の欄には、先月で飲み終えたと書けそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will record the unknown points as things to check. Can you write in the lower field that you finished taking the medicine last month?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 下の欄に先月で飲み終えたと書きます。今の薬の名前は、写真で確認できた部分だけお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 過去の薬の終了時期を書き現在の薬は写真でわかる部分のみ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will write in the lower field that I finished it last month. For my current medicine's name, I will tell you only the part that can be confirmed in the photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will write when you finished the previous medicine and give only the information about the current medicine visible in the photo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その区別で担当者へ引き継ぎます。記入が終わったら受付へお渡しください。それでは、待合でお待ちくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass that distinction on to the person in charge. When you have finished writing, please hand the form to reception. Then please wait in the waiting area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 電話についてのご相談と伺いました。まず、どのような連絡が来たのかお話しいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: I understand you would like to discuss some phone calls. First, could you tell me what kind of contact you received?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 知らない番号から、家族の荷物を預かっているという留守番電話が二回入りました。折り返すよう言われています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 知らない番号が家族の荷物を理由に二度折返しを求めたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: An unknown number left two voicemail messages saying they are holding a parcel for my family. They told me to call back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that an unknown number twice requested a callback about a parcel for your family.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 相手がそう言ったのですね。家族の方が荷物を頼んだことは、もう確認できていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: That is what the caller said, then. Have you confirmed that your family actually ordered a parcel?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家族にはまだ聞けていません。相手が名前を知っていたので、本当なのかと気になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族には確認しておらず名前を知っている相手が気になると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not been able to ask my family yet. Since the caller knew their name, I am wondering whether it is true.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have not checked with your family and are concerned because the caller knew their name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 名前を言ったことと、荷物の話が確かであることは分けて整理しましょう。録音と着信の時刻は残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us distinguish between the fact that they said a name and whether the parcel story is reliable. Do you still have the recording and the times of the calls?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 録音は残っています。一回目は昨日の夜、二回目は今朝で、同じ番号でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 録音が残り昨日の夜と今朝に同じ番号から来たと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I still have the recordings. The first call was last night and the second was this morning, both from the same number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have the recordings and that the same number called last night and this morning.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その時刻も相談内容に含められます。電話の中で、ご自身の情報を伝えたことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can include those times in the consultation. Have you given the caller any personal information during a call?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 電話には出ていないので、住所や口座番号は伝えていません。録音を聞いてもらうにはどうすればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 電話に出ず住所や口座番号を伝えていないと示し録音の確認方法を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I did not answer, so I have not given my address or account number. How can I have someone listen to the recordings?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you did not answer or give your address or account number, and ask how to have the recordings checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この練習場面では、相談担当に録音の確認方法を尋ねます。残っている記録を消さず、その内容を説明できるようにしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: In this practice scenario, we will ask the consultation staff how to check the recordings. Do not delete the remaining records, and be ready to explain their contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 着信と録音を残したまま、二回の時刻と、こちらから情報を伝えていないことを担当者に説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 記録を保ち二回の時刻と情報未提供を担当者へ説明すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will keep the call history and recordings and explain to the person in charge the times of the two calls and that I have not given any information.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will keep the records and tell the person in charge the two call times and that you provided no information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、その記録を基に相談を続けましょう。担当への引継ぎをしますので、こちらで少しお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let us continue the consultation using those records. I will hand this over to the person in charge, so please wait here a moment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 箱のふたはまだ閉じていないのですね。中に何を入れて送るご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have not closed the box lid yet. What are you planning to put inside and send?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 紙で作った立体の作品です。友人へ送りたいのですが、箱を少し動かすと中でずれます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 紙の立体作品を友人へ送るが箱を動かすと中でずれると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is a three-dimensional artwork made of paper. I want to send it to a friend, but it shifts inside when I move the box a little.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you want to send a paper three-dimensional artwork to a friend, but it shifts when you move the box.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 作品を潰さずに動きを抑えたいのですね。空いている部分と、触れると困る部分を説明していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: You want to stop it moving without crushing it. Could you explain where there is empty space and which parts must not be touched?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 底の台は丈夫ですが、上の花びらには触れたくありません。横に広い隙間があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 底の台は丈夫で上の花びらは触れたくなく横に隙間があると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The base at the bottom is sturdy, but I do not want anything touching the petals on top. There is a wide gap at the side.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the bottom base is sturdy, the upper petals should not be touched, and there is a gap at the side.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、底の台が動かないようにする方法を考えましょう。ここでは無事に届くことを保証はできませんが、箱の状態は確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let us consider how to keep the bottom base from moving. We cannot guarantee it will arrive undamaged here, but we can check the condition of the box.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 台の周りに詰める紙を持っています。いったん詰め直してから、箱の大きさを見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 詰め紙を持っており梱包後の箱の大きさを確認してもらいたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have paper to pack around the base. Could you check the box size after I repack it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have packing paper and ask them to check the box size after you repack it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 詰め直した後の箱で伺いましょう。宛先のラベルは、折り目にかからず貼れる場所がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us discuss it using the box after you have repacked it. Is there somewhere to attach the address label without putting it over a crease?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ふたの中央に貼れます。ただ、友人の部屋番号を書き忘れたので、閉じる前に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ラベルをふた中央に貼れるが部屋番号を確認してから閉じると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: It can go in the middle of the lid. But I forgot to write my friend's apartment number, so I will check it before closing the box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the label can go in the center of the lid, but you will check the apartment number before closing it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 宛先がそろってから持ち込むと相談が進めやすいです。送る方法も、その箱で比べましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Having the complete address when you bring it in will make the discussion easier. Let us compare shipping methods using that box as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は受付を進めず、台を固定して部屋番号を確かめます。準備した箱を持ってもう一度相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 台の固定と部屋番号の確認を済ませ箱を持って再相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not proceed with shipping today. I will secure the base and check the apartment number. I will bring the prepared box and ask again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will secure the base, check the apartment number, and bring the box for another consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 作品に合う準備ができましたら、箱を見ながらお話ししましょう。それでは、また窓口へお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Once you have prepared it appropriately for the artwork, let us discuss it while looking at the box. Please bring it to the counter again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込の入力前に確認したい箇所があるとのことですね。どの欄でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You said there is something you want to check before entering a transfer. Which field is troubling you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 請求書には南支店とありますが、私のメモには北支店とあります。どちらを入れたらよいかわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 請求書は南支店で自分のメモは北支店という違いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The invoice says South Branch, but my note says North Branch. I do not know which one to enter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese the discrepancy between South Branch on the invoice and North Branch in your note.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ここで相手の正しい指定を選ぶことはできません。メモは、いつ何を見て書いたものでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We cannot choose the recipient's correct instructions here. When did you make the note, and what did you copy it from?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 前の請求書から先月書き写しました。今回は新しい請求書が届いたので、変更があったのかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 先月の古い請求書を書き写し今回は変更があるかもしれないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I copied it from the previous invoice last month. A new invoice arrived this time, so there may have been a change.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you copied an old invoice last month and there may have been a change this time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 変更か書き写しの違いか、請求元に確かめたいですね。この練習では、確認が済むまで入力を止めておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: You should check with the issuer whether it is a change or a copying discrepancy. In this exercise, let us stop entering information until it is confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 入力は止めます。請求元には、支店名だけでなく口座番号と名義も聞き直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 入力を止め請求元へ支店名と口座番号と名義を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will stop entering it. I want to ask the issuer again not only for the branch name, but also the account number and account holder's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will stop entry and confirm the branch, account number, and account name with the invoice issuer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 請求書の該当欄を見せながら尋ねると、違いを説明しやすいでしょう。回答を受けた後の入力も照合が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Showing the relevant fields on the invoice when asking should make the discrepancy easier to explain. You will need to compare your entry with the information even after receiving a reply.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 返事をメモして、請求書の欄と照合します。古いメモには、確認中という印を付けておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 回答と請求書を照合し古いメモに確認中の印を付けると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will write down the reply and compare it with the invoice fields. I will mark the old note as being checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will compare the reply with the invoice and mark the old note as being checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 二つのメモを取り違えない準備になりますね。金額や支払期日の欄にも疑問はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: That will help prevent mixing up the two notes. Do you have any questions about the amount or payment due date fields?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その二つは請求書で読み取れています。振込先の返事を受けてから、全体を確かめて手続きを相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 金額と期日は読めており振込先の返答後に全体を確認して相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I can read both of those on the invoice. After receiving a reply about the transfer destination, I will check everything and ask about the procedure.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you can read the amount and due date and will check everything and seek help after receiving the destination details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認した内容がそろいましたら、続きの操作について伺います。それでは、請求元への確認後にまたご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Once you have all the confirmed information, we can discuss the remaining steps. Please ask us again after checking with the invoice issuer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 次の方どうぞ。かごの中の商品で、先にお申し出になりたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Next customer, please. Is there anything about the items in your basket you would like to tell us first?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 卵の一つにひびがあるのに気づきました。会計に入れる前に見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 卵の一つのひびを見てもらってから会計したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I noticed a crack in one of the eggs. Could you check it before including it in the bill?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to have the cracked egg checked before checkout.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらで状態を確認します。同じ商品を探す間、ほかのお買物はこのかごの内容でそろっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check its condition. While we look for the same product, are the other items in this basket everything you need?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ほかはこれで全部です。卵は同じ数の商品がなければ、今日は買わずに済ませたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 他の商品はそろっており同じ数の卵がなければ買わないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: These are all the other things. If there is no pack with the same number of eggs, I would rather not buy eggs today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have all the other items and will not buy eggs if a pack containing the same number is unavailable.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 在庫を確認する係へ伝えます。袋はお持ちでしょうか。飲み物が重いので、分け方も考えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will tell the staff member checking stock. Have you brought bags? The drinks are heavy, so let us also consider how to separate them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 大きい袋と小さい袋を持っています。飲み物は大きい方、卵は小さい方に入れたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 手持ちの大小二袋で飲み物と卵を分けたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have a large bag and a small one. I want to put the drinks in the large one and the eggs in the small one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to separate the drinks and eggs using your large and small bags.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのように分けるご希望ですね。卵を確認する間にお支払いを進めず、商品が決まってからまとめましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: That is how you would like them separated. Shall we wait to take payment until the items are decided, rather than proceeding while the eggs are being checked?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、卵が決まるまで会計を待ちます。支払いにはこの練習用の商品券を使えるかも確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 卵の確認を待ち商品券の利用可否も確かめたいと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, I will wait until the eggs are decided before paying. I would also like to check whether I can use this practice gift certificate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will wait for the egg check and also want to confirm whether the gift certificate can be used.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 券の表示を見て、この練習場面での扱いを確認します。使えない場合は、別の方法をご用意できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check the wording on the voucher and how it is handled in this practice scenario. If it cannot be used, can you provide another payment method?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 使えなければ現金で支払います。卵の確認が済んでから合計を聞き、袋を二つに分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 券が使えなければ現金を使い商品確定後に合計を聞いて袋を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: If I cannot use it, I will pay cash. After the eggs have been checked, I will ask for the total and separate the items into two bags.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will use cash if the voucher cannot be used, ask the total once the items are decided, and use separate bags.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 商品の確認が済み次第、合計をお伝えします。お手数ですが、そのままお待ちください。お帰りの際は袋を気をつけてお持ちくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: As soon as the items have been checked, I will tell you the total. Thank you for your patience; please wait as you are. Please take care carrying your bags when you leave.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 園内図をお探しですか。散歩する時間や、戻って来たい場所があれば教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a park map? Please tell me how long you want to walk and whether there is somewhere you need to return to.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二十分後に入口で友人と会います。その前に少し歩きたいのですが、入口へ戻れる短い道はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二十分後に入口で友人と会うので戻れる短い散歩道を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am meeting a friend at the entrance in twenty minutes. I would like a short walk beforehand. Is there a short path that brings me back to the entrance?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for a short walking path returning to the entrance because you are meeting a friend there in twenty minutes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この練習用の図なら、池の手前を回る道が短いですね。池を一周すると、もっと距離があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: On this practice map, the path looping around before the pond is short. Going all the way around the pond is farther.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 池を一周せず手前で戻りたいです。途中で座って休める場所も図にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 池一周を避けて手前で戻ると述べ途中で座る場所を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I want to turn back before the pond rather than go all the way around. Does the map show somewhere to sit and rest on the way?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to turn back before the pond rather than circle it, and ask about seating along the way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分かれ道の横にベンチの印があります。ただ、着いてみて空いていなければ、その先へ進むより戻る案もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: There is a bench symbol beside the fork. But if it is occupied when you get there, returning rather than continuing farther is another option.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ベンチが空いていなければ入口へ戻ります。分かれ道では、どの目印を見れば道を間違えずに済みますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ベンチが空いていなければ入口へ戻ると決め分かれ道の目印を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: If the bench is occupied, I will return to the entrance. What landmark should I look for at the fork to avoid taking the wrong path?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will return to the entrance if the bench is occupied, and ask for a landmark at the fork.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 図には花壇の印があります。現地の表示と照らして、入口の方向を確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The map has a flowerbed symbol. Compare it with the signs on site to check the direction of the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 花壇と表示を見ます。もし道が閉じていたら別の道を探さず、来た道で戻ってもよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 花壇と表示を見て道が閉じていれば迂回せず来た道を戻る案を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will look for the flowerbed and signs. If the path is closed, is it all right to return the way I came without looking for another route?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check the flowerbed and signs and suggest returning the way you came, without a detour, if the path is closed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 時間が限られているので、無理に遠回りをしない計画ですね。案内表示を見て、わからなければ係に尋ねてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: That is a plan to avoid forcing a long detour with limited time. Look at the signs and ask an attendant if you are unsure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 短い道だけ歩き、休めなかったり進めなかったりしたら入口へ戻ります。集合前に戻れるよう時計も見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 休憩や通行ができなければ入口へ戻り時計で集合前の帰着を確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will only take the short path and return to the entrance if I cannot rest or go through. I will also check my watch so I return before our meeting.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will return to the entrance if you cannot rest or pass through, and check your watch to arrive before the meeting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 図をお持ちになって、ゆっくりお楽しみください。それでは、入口での待合せにも間に合いますように。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Take the map with you and enjoy a leisurely walk. I hope you make it back in time for your meeting at the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今の案内では列車が遅れています。到着後にお約束がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: According to the current information, the train is delayed. Do you have an appointment after you arrive?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人が向こうの駅まで迎えに来ます。いつ着くか聞かれましたが、まだ答えられません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人が迎えに来るが到着時刻を答えられないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: A friend is coming to pick me up at the station at the other end. They asked when I would arrive, but I cannot answer yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that a friend is coming to pick you up, but you cannot say when you will arrive.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 到着時刻はまだ確定していません。友人には遅延していることを伝えましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The arrival time has not yet been confirmed. Have you told your friend about the delay?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 遅れていることだけ伝えました。分数を決めつけず、次の案内を待つと知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 遅延の分数を推測せず次の案内を待つと友人に伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have only told them it is delayed. I will say I am waiting for the next update without assuming how many minutes it will be.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Tell your friend in Japanese that you will wait for the next update without guessing the number of minutes of delay.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それがよいですね。案内を待っている間は、この待合室をご利用になれます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: That sounds good. You may use this waiting room while waiting for information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ここで待ちます。放送を聞き逃した場合、どの表示を見ればよいでしょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 待合室で待ち放送を逃した際に見る表示を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will wait here. Which display should I check if I miss an announcement?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will wait in the waiting room and ask which display to check if you miss an announcement.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 出発案内の列車名を見てください。表示が変わっても分からなければ声をかけてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Look for your train's name on the departure display. If the display changes and you still do not understand, please ask us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 列車名で確かめます。友人には改札で待たず、連絡するまで休める場所にいてもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 列車名で確認し友人には休める場所で連絡を待ってもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will check by the train name. I will ask my friend to wait somewhere they can rest until I contact them, rather than at the ticket gates.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check the train name and ask your friend to wait for your call somewhere they can rest.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 迎えの場所も後で確認できますね。列車に乗れたらもう一度連絡されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can confirm the pickup location later too. Will you contact your friend again once you have boarded?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 乗れたら連絡し、到着の案内が分かった時点で待合せ場所を決め直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 乗車時に連絡し到着案内を受けて待合せ場所を決め直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will contact them when I board and choose a new meeting place once I know the arrival information.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will contact your friend on boarding and rearrange the meeting place after receiving arrival information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。表示を見ながらお待ちください。移動の際はお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please wait while watching the display. Take care when you move.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 相談先を探していらっしゃるのですね。画面ではどの項目を選びましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are looking for somewhere to seek advice. Which category did you select on the screen?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 住まいの項目を選びました。でも、家賃だけでなく毎月の生活費全体について相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 住まいを選んだが生活費全体を相談したいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I selected housing. But I want to discuss all my monthly living expenses, not just rent.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you selected housing but want advice about your overall living expenses.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 住まいだけの相談とは内容が違うかもしれません。何が一番お困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: That may be different from a housing-only consultation. What is your main difficulty?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 勤務時間が減って、収入と支出の整理ができません。制度を申請するかどうかもまだ決めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 勤務時間減少で家計整理に困り制度申請は未決定と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: My working hours have decreased, and I cannot organize my income and spending. I have not decided whether to apply for any assistance program either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that reduced working hours have made household budgeting difficult and you have not decided about applying for assistance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、その内容を伝えて相談先を確かめましょう。相談できる時間帯に希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let us explain that and check where you can seek advice. Do you have a preferred time for the consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 平日の午前なら電話に出られます。予約が必要かも含めて、担当の案内を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 平日午前の電話希望を伝え予約の要否を担当に聞きたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can answer calls on weekday mornings. I would like to hear the staff's guidance, including whether an appointment is needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you prefer calls on weekday mornings and want to ask the person in charge whether an appointment is needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 受付方法は担当に確認します。電話で説明するとき、困っていることを短くまとめられそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check the intake procedure with the staff. Can you briefly summarize your difficulties when explaining them over the phone?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 収入が減り、生活費の見直しを相談したいと伝えます。持ち物はそのときに聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 収入減と生活費見直しを伝え持ち物も電話で聞くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will say my income has decreased and I want advice about reviewing living expenses. I will ask what to bring at that time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will explain your reduced income and desire to review living expenses, and ask what to bring over the phone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その伝え方で用件が分かりますね。連絡先を書き留める紙はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: That explanation makes your purpose clear. Do you have paper to write down the contact details?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 手帳があります。窓口名と連絡先を別々に書いて、電話をかける前に読み返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 手帳に窓口名と連絡先を分けて書き電話前に読み返すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have a planner. I will write the office name and contact details separately and read them again before calling.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Answer in Japanese that you will write the office name and contact details separately in your planner and reread them before calling.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当の案内を確かめて書きましょう。ご相談が進むよう願っています。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let us check the staff's guidance and write it down. I hope your consultation goes smoothly. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 会計はお済みですか。手元の書類で分からないことがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you finished paying? Is there anything you do not understand about the documents you have?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。職場から受診したことが分かる紙を出すよう言われました。この領収書でよいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 受診を示す紙を求められ領収書でよいか迷うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My workplace asked me to submit a paper showing I had a medical consultation. I am unsure whether this receipt is sufficient.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that your workplace wants proof of your medical visit and you are unsure whether the receipt is sufficient.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 職場が何を求めているかは、こちらでは分かりません。病名を書いた書類という指定はありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We do not know what your workplace requires. Did they specifically ask for a document stating the diagnosis?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 病名の指定は聞いていません。勝手に詳しい情報を出す前に、必要な内容を職場に確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 病名指定がなく詳しい情報を出す前に職場の必要内容を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not heard any requirement for a diagnosis. Before giving detailed information on my own, I want to check with work what they need.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that no diagnosis was specified and you will ask work what information is needed before providing details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な内容が分かったら、書類について受付へ相談してください。今お持ちの紙は何枚ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Once you know what is required, please ask reception about the document. How many papers do you have now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 領収書と明細書の二枚です。なくさないように袋に入れ、どちらも手元に残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 領収書と明細書の二枚を袋に入れて残すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Two: a receipt and an itemized statement. I will put them in a bag so I do not lose them and keep both with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Answer in Japanese that you will keep both the receipt and itemized statement in a bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そうしてください。受付で相談するときは、職場からの依頼文があると説明しやすいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do that. When you ask reception, a written request from work would make it easier to explain.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 口頭でしか聞いていないので、書類名と必要な項目をメッセージでもらうよう頼みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 口頭の依頼を文面にして書類名と必要項目を受け取ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: They only told me verbally, so I will ask them to send me a message giving the document name and required information.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will ask for the verbal request in writing, including the document name and required information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 依頼が分かれば、発行を相談する相手に伝えられます。診察の内容についての質問もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once the request is clear, you can explain it to the person you ask about issuance. Do you also have any questions about your consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は書類のことだけです。職場の返答を見て、受付に発行の相談をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 診察の質問ではなく職場の返答後に受付へ書類相談すると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today I only have questions about the documents. I will check work's reply and ask reception about issuing the document.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that your question is about paperwork, not the medical consultation, and you will ask reception after work replies.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。会計の紙も忘れずにお持ちください。どうぞお気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please remember to take the payment documents too. Take care on your way home.
